messages:
jess: need a quick sudo window (approx 1h) to pull a small sample of prod logs and run the redaction script for a privacy ticket. only touching public.user_events and a couple of ids. starting asap if approved.
kevin: can you paste the exact commands + justification and list any KMS unwraps? also who will own the rollback if something wrong.
jess: justification: privacy request to remove leaked emails from a subset of events for SEC-4821. commands: ```gcloud compute ssh prod-db --command "psql -d prod -c "COPY (SELECT * FROM public.user_events WHERE id IN (12345,67890)) TO STDOUT" > /tmp/sample.csv && /srv/tools/redact.sh /tmp/sample.csv --audit-log> /tmp/sample.redacted.csv"``` no KMS unwrapping planned, using read-only DB creds. owner: me (jess).
oncall-bot: Reminder: please open a break-glass request if this requires >30m or any schema writes.
kevin: sounds ok but need the ticket link and a precise time window. also we require audit logging enabled for the session. set `REDACT_AUDIT=true` in env or attach --log-audit.
jess: ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4821. window request: 13:10 - 14:10 UTC (approx). will set REDACT_AUDIT.
nina: privacy ack — approved for 1h as long as you capture audit logs and limit export to the two ids. please DM me the redacted output once done.
security-bot: Policy check: user jess has baseline prod-read, not prod-write. Script appears read-only then transform locally; ok. Ensure no raw export to external storage.
kevin: granting ephemeral sudo for 60m starting 1715003400 (13:10 UTC). I'll shadow the session. react with :white_check_mark: when you start.
jess: thanks — starting now, will ping when finished and upload the redacted sample to the privacy ticket.
kevin: saw the run, audit logs look good. closing sudo window early at 13:45 UTC since task done. :thumbsup:
security-bot: Auto-note added to SEC-4821: ephemeral sudo granted and closed; audit logs retained for 90 days.
